# Feature: Life preserver — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #61 (Life preserver) from Gear and Items before it is used in real levels. Effect: Float across water, take one inventory slot. Unique: a preserver, not flippers; you float on water instead of swimming it. Useful: carrying it trades a key slot for a water route. Source status in the candidate file is 'revised'; it was revised from human review and is now treated as a trial candidate.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** float across water, take one inventory slot.

**So that** carrying it trades a key slot for a water route.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Life preserver for the first time in its teaching room (mech-61-life-preserver-room). Teaching moment: First room: a life preserver on the near bank and deep water beyond it. A player who wades straight in without picking it up is returned to the checkpoint as soon as the water deepens, which teaches that the preserver is the permission and that deep water will still cost two moves a tile once they have it. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Picking it up fills one inventory slot
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: While held, water tiles are walkable and deep water still costs two moves per tile (41)
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Without it, entering deep water sends you back to your checkpoint
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It is held for the rest of the level

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Life preserver's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-61-life-preserver-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/gear-and-items.yml mechanic #61.
